events.title: Next Fest demo update: six new eras, from Dynastic Egypt to Yayoi Japan
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has started, and the free demo of Hist Maker: ReMake has been updated with six new eras. Hist Maker: ReMake is a history puzzle game about combining things. Put people, objects and institutions together, two at a time, and piece an era back together. Large-scale casting and a ding cauldron, for example, give you the Houmuwu ding. Each discovery comes with a historical source and a short explanation, and the civilization panorama along the bottom fills in as you go. {STEAM_CLAN_IM

events.title: The free Hist Maker: ReMake demo is out now! Play 8 levels plus the tutorial
events.summary: Hi everyone! The free Hist Maker: ReMake demo is now available on Steam!This demo includes all 8 current levels and the tutorial, free to play. These levels have been remade from the original Hist Maker, with a redesigned interface and newly illustrated civilization panoramas. Returning players can see how familiar puzzles have changed, while newcomers can start with the tutorial.Hist Maker: ReMake is a history-themed element-combination puzzle game. Choose two elements you've already discovered
